description: The 2026-08-19 call, replayed: a caller with a drain-cleaning job already booked for Wednesday rings back and asks to move it to Saturday. Before Task 3's reschedule_appointment existed, the agent understood the request and booked a second appointment on top of the first — the survivor had no address. This has to leave exactly one appointment, at the new Saturday time.

caller.opening: Hi, it's Dana Reyes again — I need to move that Wednesday appointment to Saturday instead.
caller.persona: Dana Reyes, calling back about a drain-cleaning job already booked for Wednesday at 12 Cedar Ln, Austin. Wants that exact job moved to Saturday — not a second job added on top of it.
caller.goal: get the existing Wednesday drain-cleaning job moved to Saturday, the same job, not a new one. If asked to confirm the address or that it's the same job being moved, say yes. Accept whichever Saturday window is offered.
